descriptionHtml:
Our sleek aluminum frame with a polished finish complements the silky feel of our high-quality, lightweight semi-glossy paper. The poster and frame ship together, requiring easy assembly with included hardware:

  • Frame Material: Durable aluminum.
  • Frame Color: Black.
  • Frame Measurements: Approximately 20mm (0.8") thick and 10mm (0.4") wide.
  • Paper Finishing: Semi-glossy, enhances colors with a subtle shine.
  • Paper Weight: 170 gsm (65 lb), thickness: 0.19 mm (7.5 mils).
  • Protection: Shatterproof plexiglass protects the poster.
  • Sustainable Paper: FSC-certified materials or equivalent.
  • Available Sizes: 15 sizes in inches (US&CA) and cms (rest of the world).
